title: API docs got more practical
summary:
A documentation-and-observability day: clearer image uploads, a new community project, and better signals from the cache layer.

The API documentation was refreshed and now includes base64 image-upload examples, giving builders a clearer path from encoded image data to generated pixels.

VibeCoder by Aashir Shaikh was added to the project directory: another small proof that people keep finding strange and useful things to build with a few HTTP calls.

The Cloudflare image-cache worker now emits analytics events, making it easier to observe how the image delivery layer behaves in the wild.
